dungeonPerks.name: Ember Edge
dungeonPerks.description: Every style ignites its target with a small burn.

dungeonPerks.name: Winter Thread
dungeonPerks.description: Every style chills the enemies it hits.

dungeonPerks.name: Soul Conductor
dungeonPerks.description: Hits can arc to another nearby enemy.

dungeonPerks.name: Dungeon Ward
dungeonPerks.description: A small ward reduces incoming damage throughout this Dungeon.

Melee.name: Wide Sweep
Melee.description: Each rank adds one sweep target and 12% melee reach.

Ranged.name: Piercing Flight
Ranged.description: Projectiles pierce one more target per rank, keeping 84% damage after each.

Mage.name: Guided Hex
Mage.description: Projectiles seek targets, prioritizing elites and bosses. Each rank improves steering.

Melee.name: Echoing Cut
Melee.description: A hit can send a weak blade into another nearby target.

Ranged.name: Many Arrows
Ranged.description: Fire one extra arrow per rank, each dealing 15% damage.

Mage.name: Rebounding Spell
Mage.description: Projectiles ricochet to another enemy per rank, keeping 70% damage.

dungeonPerks.name: Spellbreaker
dungeonPerks.description: Hits can briefly disable enemy totems. One disruption can occur every eight seconds.

dungeonPerks.name: Cold Verdict
dungeonPerks.description: Defeating a chilled enemy releases a small damaging burst.

Melee.name: Returning Slash
Melee.description: Occasional hits throw a blade that returns to you.

Ranged.name: Returning Shaft
Ranged.description: Occasional shots release an arrow that returns to you.

Mage.name: Returning Orb
Mage.description: Occasional spells release an orb that returns to you.

dungeonPerks.name: Gravitation
dungeonPerks.description: Kills draw nearby ordinary enemies together, setting up area attacks.

dungeonPerks.name: Mirrorcraft
dungeonPerks.description: Successful reflect wards return extra damage and briefly disrupt the caster’s totems.

migration.refund: Unspent seals plus the full historical price of all purchased ranks

preparationEconomy.credit: One-time price difference for owned refinement/speed ranks and Steel promotions

skillingBonuses.clock: Real seconds of active work in the matching activity
skillingBonuses.stacking: Strongest only; equal refreshes, weaker grants output

silence.name: Totem Silence
silence.description: Disable every enemy totem while this blessing lasts

quagmire.name: Stillworld
quagmire.description: All enemy movement is halved, including charges

bounty.name: Golden Hunt
bounty.description: Each non-summoned kill grants 1 extra gold

harvest.name: Plentiful Hunt
harvest.description: +50% material drop chance; drops remain rare

cascade.name: Chain Reaction
cascade.description: Hits have a 22% chance to arc to another enemy

longarm.name: Long Reach
longarm.description: +25% attack reach for Melee, Mage and Ranged

positioning.eligible: Elites, rares and guardian Echoes; full-boss scripts preserved
positioning.healingRetreats: Natural ordinary/uncommon; one per active unblocked healing totem

furnace.lifetime: All cores passed player, enemies and viewport

eliteTasks.eligible: Natural elites, rares and guardian Echoes; full bosses and summons excluded

encounters.healthCalibration: Per-enemy hpScale, ordinary wave counts/cadence and player damage are preserved; interludes add 4/5/6 packs and eligible uncommons have twice ordinary HP

gravePulse.name: Grave Pulse
gravePulse.hint: Expanding bone ring · dash through the rim

ringchain.name: Rebounding Barrage
ringchain.hint: Three rings · gaps rotate · violet shots rebound

bloom.name: Growing Stars
bloom.hint: Projectiles grow · leave a wider gap

return.name: Homeward Blades
return.hint: Red blades turn home · watch the return path

crossfire.name: Crossfire
crossfire.hint: Violet cross · lure enemies into the lanes

sunder.name: Threefold Ruin
sunder.hint: Three red quarters · enter the teal quarter

gauntlet.name: Marching Ruin
gauntlet.hint: Red lanes strike in numbered order

donut.name: Outer Ruin
donut.hint: Enter the teal circle · avoid the red ring

pincer.name: Closing Jaws
pincer.hint: Two violet sweeps · use the gap

summon.name: Calling Spire
summon.hint: Bump once to break · dash or wait while red

eliteSummon.name: Royal Calling
eliteSummon.hint: Bump twice · step away between hits · dash or wait while red

reversal.name: Hungry Mirror
reversal.hint: Touch the gold rune; step out first if it appears under you · missing hurts and heals the boss

minefield.name: Marked Ground
minefield.hint: Red marks lock on cast · step between them

tether.name: Siphon Tether
tether.hint: Dash away from the caster or through the teal knot

orbit.name: Orbital Blades
orbit.hint: Red blades orbit then fly outward

eruptionTrail.name: Ruinous Rush
eruptionTrail.hint: Violet charge leaves a burning trail

burrowingBriar.name: Burrowing Briar
burrowingBriar.guide: Move after the root stops tracking

walkingHedge.name: Walking Hedge
walkingHedge.guide: Cross the offset teal openings; hedges keep travelling and do not refund dash

briarLeash.name: Briar Leash
briarLeash.guide: Dash across the tether to cut it

sporeFan.name: Spore Fan
sporeFan.guide: Step between spores and their clouds

clingingSeeds.name: Clinging Seeds
clingingSeeds.guide: A dash shakes off attached seeds

graftedSwap.name: Grafted Swap
graftedSwap.guide: Both root portals preview the swap

rollingFurnace.name: Rolling Furnace
rollingFurnace.guide: Read the bank marks: repeated rollers, splitting cores or crossing bankshots

furnaceVents.name: Furnace Vents
furnaceVents.guide: Follow the grates lighting in order

coolingIslands.name: Cooling Islands
coolingIslands.guide: Move to the next cooling island

cinderStitch.name: Cinder Stitch
cinderStitch.guide: Cross before the stitched trail ignites

moltenDroplets.name: Molten Droplets
moltenDroplets.guide: Splash marks include the smaller bursts

slagAnchors.name: Slag Anchors
slagAnchors.guide: Dash through an anchor to tear the fire curtain

emberCatch.name: Ember Catch
emberCatch.guide: Touch the gold ember to return a violet blast

boneLoom.name: Bone Loom
boneLoom.guide: Thread the wide corridor between the ribs

soulLantern.name: Soul Lantern
soulLantern.guide: Intercept healing souls or dash through the lantern

hauntedFootsteps.name: Haunted Footsteps
hauntedFootsteps.guide: The ghost repeats the marked route

graveClock.name: Grave Clock
graveClock.guide: Use the broken hand; it reverses after a pause

returningSigil.name: Returning Sigil
returningSigil.guide: Touch each gold rune before its arc runs out

ribcageRise.name: Ribcage Rise
ribcageRise.guide: Leave through the opening before the ribs collapse

hollowChorus.name: Hollow Chorus
hollowChorus.guide: Raised lanterns show the order of the waves

borrowedBreath.name: Borrowed Breath
borrowedBreath.guide: Visit a teal stone before the curse closes

gravityWell.name: Gravity Well
gravityWell.guide: Escape the pull before its burst

orbitTransfer.name: Orbit Transfer
orbitTransfer.guide: Watch the bridge and the blade’s next owner

stargateVolley.name: Stargate Volley
stargateVolley.guide: The second portal previews the exit direction

constellationCage.name: Constellation Cage
constellationCage.guide: Leave the outlined triangle before it connects

riftScissors.name: Rift Scissors
riftScissors.guide: Use the openings beyond the crescent tips

collapsingNova.name: Collapsing Nova
collapsingNova.guide: Counter the gold rune or cross the delayed pulse

prismRelay.name: Prism Relay
prismRelay.guide: Read the beam’s route through both crystals

turningBulwark.name: Turning Bulwark
turningBulwark.guide: Circle behind the rotating front shield

rallyThread.name: Rally Thread
rallyThread.guide: Dash across the enemy buff thread

summons.retaliation: Only while summoning; normal defenses and invulnerability apply

zonePressure.scenario: First Zone 2 guardian, basic Iron ranged armor, approximately 55 DPS, no perks/blessings, real health/ammo/damage; deterministic stationary and counterplay bots

zoneChallengePressure.scenario: Approximately 150 DPS bow and reinforced Steel ranged armor, actual spawning/health/ammo/damage, no purchased combat perks; deterministic stationary and counterplay controllers
